in_sanskrit.name: सर्मिला
in_sanskrit.meaning: Beautiful woman with a graceful body
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सर् (sar) meaning 'body' + मिल (mila) meaning 'graceful' + ा (a) meaning 'feminine' = सर्मिला (Sarmila)

in_hindi.name: सर्मिला
in_hindi.meaning: सरूपा (sarupa) meaning 'having a beautiful form' or 'graceful'

in_tamil.name: சர்மிலா
in_tamil.meaning: ஸரம் (saram) meaning 'body' + இலா (ilam) meaning 'grace' or 'graceful' = சர்மிலா (Sarmila)

in_telugu.name: శర్మిళ
in_telugu.meaning: శరోపిణి (saropini) meaning 'having a beautiful form' or 'graceful'

in_marathi.name: Sarmila
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of the night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarmila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is like a star in the night sky

in_bengali.name: Sarmila
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Star of the night
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sarmila একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is like a star in the night sky
